---
title: Last observation carried forward
description: Fill gaps in your data by carrying the last observation forward
products: [cloud, mst, self_hosted]
keywords: [hyperfunctions, Toolkit, gapfilling, interpolate, locf]
---

**Last observation carried forward (LOCF)** fills gaps by repeating the last known value until the next sample arrives. Use it when a stepped or held reading matches your signal better than drawing a straight line between points.

For more information about gapfilling and interpolation API calls, see the
[hyperfunction API documentation](/reference/timescaledb/hyperfunctions/time_bucket_gapfill/locf).
